title: Citi, DBS complete first weekend tokenized cross-border deposit on Swift
summary: Citi and DBS completed their first tokenized cross-border transfer over the weekend, using Swift’s blockchain-based ledger to circumvent the constraints of traditional banking hours.

title: Philippines eyes payment operator registration freeze, tighter VASP checks
summary: A central bank proposal would pause new payment operator registrations while requiring enhanced monitoring and transaction limits for arrangements involving virtual asset firms.
